title: With Aquino at the AFIO meeting in Las Vegas

tellings.quote: So, he says, "We're going to go to Vegas. Las Vegas is having a meeting of the Association of Former Intelligence Officers,

plain: An author who writes about the history of intelligence and the occult, Peter Levenda, says a man named Michael Aquino once told him they were going to Las Vegas for a meeting of the Association of Former Intelligence Officers, a club of retired spies. Levenda says he went along, and he names John Alexander in the story, telling it as a glimpse of the circles these men moved in.
